title: 印太能源转向：核能、液化天然气、煤炭，全都要
speaker: Lee Zeldin

segments.en: One of the topics that were discussed, one of the pillars of this weekend is about the supply chain.
segments.zh: 本周末讨论的核心议题之一是供应链。

segments.en: And for Indo-Pacific countries, they are, I think, far more motivated, they were talking quite frequently about wanting to diversify their supply chain
segments.zh: 印太国家积极性更高，他们频繁提到希望实现供应链多元化。

segments.en: that they want to start looking elsewhere because they were relying too heavily on the Middle Eastern region for their supply chain. Also diversifying how they provide energy to their people.
segments.zh: 他们希望寻找其他来源，因为过去过度依赖中东。同时，他们也在推动能源供应方式的多元化。

segments.en: Some countries are further along in talking about nuclear, others relying more on LNG, others talking about coal. It really ran the gamut.
segments.zh: 一些国家在讨论核能，另一些则更依赖液化天然气，还有的考虑煤炭，选择多种多样。

segments.en: And depending on which country we were sitting in for a bilateral or for meetings amongst all the energy ministers, diversification of the supply chain was not just a pillar going into this weekend, but something that was frequently talked about throughout.
segments.zh: 在双边会谈或能源部长会议中，供应链多元化不仅是本周末的议题，更是贯穿始终的焦点。
